title: Vexal Quicksand
description: Adds an unique and a fun gameplay mechanics for players.
body:
# 🏝️ Vexal QuickSand

**Vexal QuickSand** adds realistic, smooth sinking mechanics to sand-like blocks in Minecraft.  
Players standing on configured blocks will slowly sink, struggle, and eventually drown — unless they escape in time!

Perfect for survival servers, adventure maps, traps, and RPG environments where immersion matters.

---

**Showcase Video**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8ttcDYIzwKY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

**✨ Features**

- 🏖️ Realistic quicksand sinking behavior
- 🎮 Smooth player sinking animation — NOT teleport-jump spam
- ⚙️ Configurable blocks & sinking speed
- ✅ Bypass permission for staff / special ranks
- 🔁 Reload command — no server restart required
- 🌎 **WorldGuard support** *(optional)* — prevent quicksand in protected regions

---

**📦 Requirements**

- Minecraft **1.17+**
- Paper / Spigot / Purpur
- *(Optional)* WorldGuard

---

**🛠️ Commands & Permissions**

| Command | Description |
|--------|------------|
| `/vqs reload` | Reloads the plugin config |

| Permission | Description | Default |
|-----------|------------|--------|
| `vexalquicksand.admin` | Allows use of `/vqs reload` | OP |
| `vexalquicksand.bypass` | Prevents player from sinking | OP |

---

**⚙️ Configuration**

After first startup, edit:
```/plugins/VexalQuickSand/config.yml```

**Example:**

```yaml
sinking-blocks:
  - SAND
  - RED_SAND
  - SOUL_SAND

sinking-speed: 0.03
max-sink-depth: 1.8
```

---

**💡 How It Works**
- Player stands on configured block
- Player gradually sinks
- Movement becomes sluggish
- Escape by jumping/sprinting or receive your sandy fate 🏜️
